items.author: Andrej Karpathy
items.title: On training efficiency improvements
items.content: We've achieved a 3x speedup in GPT training by optimizing the attention mechanism's memory layout. Key insight: cache-friendly tensor layouts matter more than theoretical FLOPs at scale. Details in our tech blog soon.

items.author: Anthropic Engineering
items.title: Constitutional AI: Scaling Alignment with Human Feedback
items.content: Introducing our new approach to AI alignment that combines supervised learning with a constitution defining AI behavior principles. This allows us to train helpful, harmless, and honest AI assistants at scale without requiring human feedback for every decision.
items.excerpt: We present Constitutional AI (CAI), a method for training AI systems to be helpful, harmless, and honest using a set of principles rather than extensive human oversight...

items.author: swyx
items.title: AI-first product design patterns
items.content: After shipping 5 AI products this year, I've noticed a pattern: the best AI UX doesn't try to hide the AI. Show confidence scores, allow editing, make the model transparent. Users trust what they understand.

items.author: Vercel
items.title: v0.dev hits 1M developers: Lessons in AI-powered tooling
items.content: Six months after launch, v0 has reached 1 million developers using AI to generate production-ready React components. Key learnings: iteration speed matters more than first-try perfection, and developers want control over the final output.
items.excerpt: v0.dev has crossed 1 million developers, with over 10 million components generated. Here's what we learned building an AI-first developer tool...

items.author: Josh Woodward
items.title: Cursor IDE adoption metrics
items.content: Cursor just hit 500k weekly active developers. The killer feature isn't the autocomplete - it's the ability to chat with your entire codebase. Context-aware AI is the unlock for developer tools.
